title: Garlicky Ham Stir Fry
description: A delicious german-inspired stir fry made with tender ham and a hint of moroccan spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced serrano pepper and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Add the chopped garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the thick-cut ham steak to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through.
Sprinkle the moroccan spice blend over the ham and stir to combine.
Serve the garlicky ham stir fry hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
